trans-unit.source: Saving applies these preferences now. Toolbar changes stay local and do not update your saved preferences.
Verify the new address before it becomes your primary email. We will notify your previous address and sign out your existing sessions.

Includes your profile, saved preferences, and membership metadata. This is not a workspace or document backup. It excludes passwords, sessions, authenticator secrets, recovery codes, document contents, and client keys.

Leaving takes effect immediately and removes only your membership in this workspace. Your global identity and other memberships remain. The shared workspace and its records are preserved. This does not delete your account.
